context: Two teens swap pop-culture and salon plans
purpose: Teach: 快感/マインド/ウォーター/ボブ/三角/つぶし/ヤフー/ハルヒ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、髪バッサリ切ったんだけど、ショートボブどうかな?
lines.en: Hey, I chopped my hair off. How's the short bob look?
lines.style: Excited teen girl seeking peer approval after haircut.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、めっちゃ似合ってる!ちょっと涼宮ハルヒみたいな雰囲気あるじゃん。
lines.en: Whoa, it really suits you! You've got a Haruhi Suzumiya vibe going.
lines.style: Casual teen boy giving an enthusiastic, anime-flavored compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった、それ狙ってたの!担当の美容師さん、こっちのマインド完全に読んでくれてさ。
lines.en: Yes, that's exactly what I was going for! My stylist totally got into my mindset.
lines.style: Pleased teen girl bragging playfully about a successful salon visit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいなー、俺なんか前髪が変な三角になっててさ、来週なおしに行くんだ。
lines.en: Lucky you. My bangs ended up in a weird triangle, so I'm going back next week for a fix.
lines.style: Teen boy grumbling lightly about his own hair mishap.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あはは、ヤフー知恵袋で「前髪 失敗」とか見た?暇つぶしに読むとマジで地獄だよ。
lines.en: Haha, have you seen Yahoo Answers threads about bangs disasters? Reading them to kill time is seriously brutal.
lines.style: Teasing teen girl laughing about embarrassing internet threads.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見た見た!あとさ、ミネラルウォーターのCMに出てる俳優の髪型、あれ参考にしようかなって。
lines.en: Totally read those! And I was thinking of copying that actor's hair from the mineral water commercial.
lines.style: Teen boy enthusiastically pitching a celebrity-inspired hair idea.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あの人かっこいいよね!イメチェン成功した瞬間って、なんかすごい快感あるよね。
lines.en: He's so cool! There's seriously such a rush when a makeover actually works out.
lines.style: Teen girl gushing dreamily about the thrill of self-reinvention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。じゃあ俺も気合い入れて行ってくるわ、結果報告するね!
lines.en: I get it. Alright, I'll go in with confidence and report back on the results!
lines.style: Determined teen boy wrapping up with a friendly promise.
